attributes.name: Belkzen Battle Standard
attributes.powers: When a character at your location encounters a monster, display this card next to that location. While displayed, when a character at that location attempts a combat check to defeat a monster, add 1, or 2 if that character has the Half-Orc or Orc trait. If the character fails the check, bury this card; if proficient with heavy armors, recharge this card instead of burying it.
